title: WP-90 Admin UI: who agent messages are from (Workspace settings > AI Access, read only), Check what a chat gets (agent builder), and the WP-63 Allowed websites screens it closes (C11.04)

screenshots.where: WP-63's screens (Allowed websites, Git hosts, agent narrowing, clone and upload cards, activity lines) were taken in light, dark and at 390 px by WP-63 on a lane stack. WP-90's new cards have none yet: no Playwright stack spec ran in this package; the unit tests above cover each case with Node's and Python's routes mocked

routed: Nothing new is routed: the cards use the existing policy section routes (R10, R11, If-Match), explain (R21), GET /api/v1/agents, GET /api/v1/toolsets/my-toolsets?scope=org and GET /api/v1/toolsets/agents/{agentKey}

cases.title: Check what a chat gets
steps: Open a saved agent in the agent builder
Under run settings, press Check now
expected: Runs on, Model, Coding engine, Limits per message (steps, dollars, minutes) and Who messages are from, in plain words
Tools it can use, each with its name and tool count; Not available, each with one sentence of why (connect it under Your actions, not turned on for this agent, ...)
Nothing runs and nothing is sent; no id, digest or setting name

cases.title: Check not available
steps: On a server with CONTROL_PLANE_PIN=off, press Check now
expected: 'This check isn't available on this server.' and no button

cases.title: Unsaved changes or a new agent
expected: Edited: a note that the check uses the saved agent
New: 'Save the agent to check what a chat with it gets.'

cases.title: Allowed websites (WP-63, closes C11.04)
steps: Workspace settings > Security > Allowed websites: add, edit, read-write confirm, host-level (Advanced), Changes and Restore
Agent builder > Websites this agent may use
expected: As the WP-63 mock and its screenshots; every save, narrowing and restore is one config.changed entry (WP-90 Node test)
The session level is the run's cards (clone per conversation, uploads per run), never an editor: a chat cannot widen the org's list
